title: Each SHA reader in the merge tool uses the one SHA_HEX and ls-remote home
why: Two readers of the same thing drift apart; one home keeps them in step.
note: Topic merge-tool. merge.py's revert-commit scan uses SHA_HEX, and janitor/sweep.py _live_remote_heads shares GitLock's ls-remote reader. Lane merge-lock-expired-delete-race runs it, stacked on #1708. A SHA-256 note: fix none, until 2026-11-21. Filed 19:22 CST Nov 7.
